purpose: Form INC-11B is the certificate of incorporation issued by the Registrar of Companies upon approval of the conversion of a company limited by guarantee into a company limited by shares.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within thirty days from the date of the passing of the special resolution
steps: Ensure the company has a share capital equivalent to the guarantee amount.
Pass a special resolution by members authorising the conversion, omitting the guarantee clause in the Memorandum, and altering the Articles.
File a copy of the special resolution in Form No. MGT14 with the Registrar of Companies within thirty days with the prescribed fee.
File an application in Form No. INC-27 with the Registrar of Companies within thirty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
checklist: Share capital equivalent to the guarantee amount
Altered Memorandum of Association omitting the guarantee clause
Altered Articles of Association for a company limited by shares
List of members with the number of shares held aggregating to the minimum paid up capital equivalent to the guarantee amount
attachments: list of members with the number of shares held
watch: Ensure filings in Form INC-27 and Form MGT14 are made within thirty days from the date of passing the special resolution.
